title: GLO Weekly: Global Loyalty News - March 6, 2026 (Week 10)

March 6, 2026 08:23 AM GLO Global Loyalty Predictions™ 2026: Daniel Velasco, Strategic Planner, LMS Loyalty is evolving into AI-driven, ecosystem-based business models. In 2026, expansion into new sectors, multi-partner integration, and real-time personalisation will accelerate. Investment will shift toward data infrastructure, gamification, and digital rewards. Loyalty currencies are becoming monetisable digital assets, blurring rewards and payments. Execution discipline, ROI accountability, and trust will determine long-term success. March 5, 2026 09:00 AM GLO Global Loyalty Predictions™ 2026: Michael Smith, Board Advisor, Ai Events Loyalty in 2026 will be shaped by the rapid growth of points and miles in circulation, driving focus on liability management, redemption pressure and consolidation around dominant currencies. Interchangeability between programmes is increasing, while AI-driven commerce is moving toward deployment. At the same time, inflationary dynamics and rising fraud risk present structural challenges across the industry. March 4, 2026 09:00 AM GLO Global Loyalty Predictions™ 2026: Hoa Lan Huong CEO, Vietjet / GalaxyJoy Vietjet SkyJoy delivered strong, consistent growth in 2025, with membership rising to 6.5 million and engagement supported by enhanced personalisation and a new app experience. As competition and fraud pressures increase, focus turns to sustaining relevance at scale. In 2026, the programme will shift towards a currency-led model, premium tiers and a central CDP—positioning loyalty as a strategic growth engine. March 3, 2026 10:00 AM GLO Global Loyalty Predictions™ 2026: Andy Chalcroft, Visa In 2025, loyalty accelerated through coalitions, Gen Z engagement and a shift beyond earn-and-burn towards community and experiences. Relevance emerged as a core challenge amid crowding and agentic commerce complexity. In 2026, programmes must leverage data, invest in AI-led personalisation, and shift value from pure financial rewards to exclusive access and differentiated experiences. March 2, 2026 12:00 PM ㅤAirlines, Alliances & Airports: The ultimate power duo: How Atmos™ Rewards and the oneworld® Alliance deliver a smoother, elevated global travel experience Having oneworld lounge access lets alliance benefits shine even before boarding — from a cappuccino at an Alaska Lounge to seamless entry across a global network of airline partners — and it all stems from the power of Atmos Rewards status. March 6, 2026 07:15 AM Delta Air Lines Reshuffles Leadership, Names Peter Carter President and Erik Snell CFO Delta Air Lines announced leadership changes effective April. Peter Carter will become president, succeeding Glen Hauenstein. CFO Dan Janki will move to COO, while Erik Snell becomes CFO. Other roles were also expanded as CEO Ed Bastian reshapes the leadership team. March 5, 2026 04:00 PM Korean Air to Open Renovated Flagship Lounge at Los Angeles International Airport Korean Air will open a newly renovated $44 million flagship lounge on March 6 at Los Angeles International Airport. Located in the Tom Bradley International Terminal, the two-floor facility includes a First Class lounge with private suites, à-la-carte dining and a bar, plus business and dining areas for Prestige passengers. The upgrade is part of preparations for integration with Asiana Airlines. (Image: Korean Air) March 5, 2026 03:00 PM Delta Sky Club opens at Denver International Airport, bringing Colorado’s beauty indoors The 13,000 square foot space in Concourse A invites guests into a luxurious, serene retreat with seating for 230 guests. March 5, 2026 11:00 AM New Virgin Atlantic App: The world of Virgin Atlantic, now in your pocket The app brings every trip together in one place. From booking to boarding and beyond, guests can view upcoming journeys, manage travel details and access support in real time. Designed for Flying Club members but open to all, it’s simple, accessible and secure. Members can track points, tier progress, see how close they are to rewards
